mentions.name: mu
mentions.description: A new AI agent/harness called mu that aims to do existing good ideas reasonably well while being minimalist, composable, and pragmatic. Not yet released, with plans to let people try it soon.
mentions.source_excerpt: a new agent/harness, mu. not ready yet but hope to let people play with it ~soon. its got very few novel ideas, but attempts to do the existing good ideas reasonably well and be as minimalist and composable and pragmatic as possible
mentions.author: amdahl
